<!-- ============ ABOUT ============ -->
<section id="about" class="section about">
  <h2>About</h2>
  <p>An MSc Business Analytics graduate student at Baruch College with a background in marketing, data analytics, and operations. Over the past few years, I have worked across education, tech, and construction sectors, using data to improve campaign performance, streamline operations, and support strategic decision-making.</p>

  <p>From managing student databases and analyzing web traffic to building dashboards and running A/B tests, I enjoy solving problems and finding insights that add real value. My toolkit includes <strong>Python</strong>, <strong>SQL</strong>, <strong>Excel</strong>, <strong>Tableau</strong>, <strong>Power BI</strong>, and <strong>Google Analytics</strong>.</p>

  <p>What drives me is the opportunity to work on projects that create impact, whether it is improving marketing ROI, helping students reach their goals, or building smarter systems through data.</p>
</section>
